# Carrier Medium

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:CarrierMedium`](gmeow-CarrierMedium.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/CarrierMedium>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The medium of a physical carrier — a VALUE vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses). Print, e-ink file, optical disc, and server object are examples; the set is open.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:CarrierMedium`](gmeow-CarrierMedium.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary for the material medium of a physical carrier — print, e-ink file, optical disc, server object; referenced by [`gmeow:medium`](../properties/gmeow-medium.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid confusing it with the publishable format ([`gmeow:ManifestationFormat`](gmeow-ManifestationFormat.md) — a 'paperback' is a format, 'print' is its carrier medium) and avoid per-medium subclasses.

### How to use

- Reference a seeded [`gmeow:CarrierMedium`](gmeow-CarrierMedium.md) individual from a creative work or carrier via [`gmeow:medium`](../properties/gmeow-medium.md); extend with new individuals (not subclasses) when a new substrate appears.

### Examples

- [`gmeow:mediumPrint`](../individuals/gmeow-mediumPrint.md) a [`gmeow:CarrierMedium`](gmeow-CarrierMedium.md).
